# Harmoniva

> Harmoniva is a free, AI-powered ear training and music education platform for musicians, students, teachers, and music schools. It teaches aural skills — recognising notes, intervals, chords, scales, rhythm, and melodic dictation — through interactive browser exercises, a structured learning path, music games, and a virtual piano studio. All core exercises are free and playable without an account.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://harmoniva.app/): What Harmoniva is and who it's for.
- [How It Works](https://harmoniva.app/how-it-works): Complete guide to every feature.
- [Structured Learning Path](https://harmoniva.app/learn): Free step-by-step ear-training course, beginner to advanced.
- [Exercise Setup Studio](https://harmoniva.app/exercise-setup): Build a custom ear-training workout.
- [Find Teachers & Schools](https://harmoniva.app/find-teachers): Directory of verified music teachers and schools.
- [Games](https://harmoniva.app/games): Music-learning games.
- [Piano Studio](https://harmoniva.app/piano-studio): Free virtual piano in the browser.
- [Pricing](https://harmoniva.app/pricing): Free and premium plans.

## Practice exercises (free, no account required)

- [Single Note Recognition](https://harmoniva.app/practice/single-note-practice): Identify single notes by ear.
- [Melodic Interval Ear Training](https://harmoniva.app/practice/melodic-interval-practice): Recognise intervals played one note after another.
- [Harmonic Interval Ear Training](https://harmoniva.app/practice/harmonic-interval-practice): Recognise intervals played together.
- [Interval Direction](https://harmoniva.app/practice/interval-direction-practice): Hear whether a pitch moves up or down.
- [Interval Comparison](https://harmoniva.app/practice/interval-comparison-practice): Compare two intervals by size.
- [Interval Construction](https://harmoniva.app/practice/interval-construction-practice): Build intervals on the staff.
- [Chord Recognition](https://harmoniva.app/practice/chord-practice): Identify chord types and inversions.
- [Scale & Mode Recognition](https://harmoniva.app/practice/scale-practice): Identify scales and modes.
- [Rhythm Training](https://harmoniva.app/practice/rhythm-practice): Match a heard rhythm to its notation.
- [Melodic Dictation](https://harmoniva.app/practice/melodic-dictation): Transcribe short melodies by ear.
